* Nano allies who are already in position to easily attack the enemy. If the enemy can stay away from your Nano’d ally, the ult gets completely wasted.
play_against: * Sleep Dart is Ana’s primary means of survival. If you see her shoot it or sleep an ally, that is your signal to go attack her.

minor.title: Groggy
content: * Best against dive
* * Ana is always a dive priority target, so anything that helps her counter their attacks is huge for her viability.
* The extra damage and slow debuff is basically a guaranteed kill against any hero without an invincible escape tool.
* Shutdown enemy ults
* * Sleep is already one of the best ability counters to ults in Overwatch, but the added slow can give your team the extra space they need to avoid the enemy ult after they awake.
* Ex: Ram ulting at your team, Ana Sleeps him, and by the time he wakes up, then slow walks, your team can get out of his AoE and end his ult early.

minor.title: Speed Serum
content: * Best when aggressive Nano targets like Reinhardt who struggle to chase down retreating enemies.
* If you absolutely need to, you can Nano the nearest or easiest target just to give yourself the speed boost if you will die otherwise.

major.title: Headhunter
content: * Just to flex
* * Refer to the _“Tips for Biotic Rifle”_ section, and you’ll see ADS shots against enemies have a significantly decreased bullet size. This makes landing headshots with Ana quite difficult.
* Additionally, the multiplier is only 1.5x, so the return isn’t that great.

* Head hurtboxes are mostly hidden when looking at the backs of heroes, and you’ll essentially always be looking at the backs of your teammates. Consequently, critical hits on allies are also impractical.

major.title: Biotic Bounce
content: * Win button
* * Although the damage and healing are reduced on the 2nd bounce, the anti and heal buffs are the same.
* Potentially, Ana can hit the enemy frontline with the first bounce, then mid or back enemies with the second bounce. Anti-healing on a majority of the enemy team
* Hitting a nade into a wall next to or behind a target is also a very effective means of hitting tricky angles.

content: * Best against dive comps. You can create space between yourself and the enemy with the first shot, then you have another shot to reposition even better.

major.title: Viper's Sting
content: * Best poke Perk
* * The extra damage is very powerful on maps with long sight lines. The bonus damage is also not affected by falloff, so the extra 25 damage keeps its effectiveness at all ranges.

* Also useful for pressure ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks as landing two shots in a row is very easy on their large bodies.
* Bonus damage reset
* * The “consecutive scoped shots” reset after every hit, 2 scoped shots, when missing a scoped shot, or after 3 seconds of no shots.
* Hip fire shots do not affect Viper’s Sting’s counter.

major.title: Airburst
content: * Best anti-brawl Perk
* * When the enemy team plays as a deathball, the larger AoE will help you burn more targets with each use.
* Increase ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/the-viper.png)The Viper uptime

This helps her reduce reload time and increases the time she spends firing.
* Don’t pick against a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko

* Activate ult and instantly drop one on your body and on your attackers. If allies are nearby, this should buy them enough time to peel for you.

content: * Even better for pressuring backlines

* Damage difference
* * Lower single-target damage per second output, in exchange for AoE damage.

major.title: Self-Repair
content: * Greatly increased survivability

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion is already quite tanky and with Self-Repair, he feels impossible to kill for many heroes. Primarily use to heal yourself to help out your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports and get yourself back to full health quicker.
* Increase uptime
* * During Assault mode, the enemy will target you if they don’t run away. Alternate between healing and firing so you don’t have to fully disengage.
* Counter dive by pairing with Armored Artillery

* * Against full dive comps, running these two perks give ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion the self-sustain required to survive dive attacks by multiple enemies simultaneously.

Try to not let it sit at 3 packs when you have the opportunity to swing on the enemy so that you can maximize the benefit and extra healing output.
* Good when the team needs extra healing
* * When you see the other Support struggling to keep your allies alive, Combat Medic is the way to go.

minor.title: Morale Boost
content: * Pick when struggling to keep Inspire up.
* Whip Shot and Inspire

* * Inspire lasts four seconds, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot is a four-second cooldown. Therefore, if you land two Whip Shots in a row, you won’t even be benefiting from Morale Boost.
* If you find your Inspire uptime is low or are struggling to find consistent opportunities to proc Inspire, Morale Boost can be a good choice.

major.title: Inspiring Strike
content: * Movement
* * Bash movement is one of the most important tools Brig has in her arsenal. Gaining even movement speed buff just makes it that much stronger.
* Increased aggression
* * Brig can be more aggressive with her positiong when using Inspiring Strike because she can dive and rush down enemies faster, and disengage faster as well.
* The instant Inspire healing also makes her tankier in duels.

major.title: Whiplash
content: * Situational, but clutch

* * You won’t be benefiting from wall damage every time you ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot, but when you do, the extra damage can secure kills or create the pressure needed to win the fight.
* Best on enclosed maps
* * Maps with lots of structures and walls give you more opportunities to line up wall slams.
* Try to strafe and line up enemies with any structure to get more wall slams in each game.
* Unique breakpoints
* * The extra 50 damage creates new “one-shot” combos against 225 and 275 HP heroes:
* 235 damage combo: Flail → Bash → Whip Shot-wall-slam
* 280 damage combo: Flail → Bash → Flail → Whip Shot-wall-slam

minor.title: Even the Odds
content: * Tank damage over time

* If the enemy is running Moira / Juno, for example, neither of them can burst or stun Cassidy, and he’s very likely to survive channeling Deadeye with the extra healing.
* When to avoid picking
* * If the enemy has easy ways of stopping Deadeye with stuns like Sleep Dart, or burst damage like Widow Maker, then the healing is not helpful.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
Echo’s quick movement and flying abilities are best utilized on maps with plenty of high ground and natural vertical cover. Peeking over walls, or air strafing around structures high in the air allow Echo to play more aggressively and do so more safely.
On flatter maps, as long as there are lots of side paths for flanking, Echo still performs great thanks to her silent footsteps and horizontal dashing. The maps that hinder her playstyle the most are the long range sniper maps where she has to expose herself down sightlines to approach the enemy. Echo also has difficulty on maps with large open objective areas and maps with too many small areas that hinder her movement.

play_as: * Take advantage of Echo’s silent movement and set up surprise flank attacks as often as possible.

* Wait to visually confirm an enemy’s health is below half before activating ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/focusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam, or else you’ll lose out on a lot of damage.

* Plan out your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/duplicate.png)Duplicate target ahead of time, and make sure they are in a position to be selected. As the copy, play safe until you get their ult.
play_against: * Hitscans like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/soldier-76.png)Soldier: 76 have the advantage against Echo when she’s flying around.
* Pay attention and notice if you don’t see Echo. She’s likely setting up behind you for a sneak attack, so watch your flank.

* Many Echo players use Flight to get in and attack. Dodge and get cover for a few seconds, then quickly focus her while her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/flight.png)Flight is on cooldown.

The increased range and speed enable you to position more safely and target enemies normally out of your range.

minor.title: Partial Scan
content: * Install ults

* * A good use of starting with 50% ult charge is for copying heroes with install ultimates like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonblade.png)Dragonblade, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overclock.png)Overclock, etc.
* Many times, you’ll find that without Partial Scan, by the time you generate the copied ult, your time runs out and cancels the ult.
* Prioritize earning ult
* * Partial Scan should be treated as a time extension as soon as you activate copy. Take some extra time to play safe, stay alive, and farm your copy's ult.
* Dying (copy ending) before getting ult completely wastes this Minor Perk selection.

major.title: Full Salvo
content: * Best Major Perk
* * Echo can benefit from Full Salvo every 6 seconds as compared to only benefitting from High Beams when specifically getting elims from Beam after using Flight.
* Extra burst damage
* * The math works out to roughly 30% more damage compared to regular Sticky Bombs.
* Full Salvo is more consistent at getting all DPS below half health for Focusing Beam combos (even those with high health and armor).

major.title: High Beams
content: * Full aggro beam usage
* * Being able to use Flight twice in a row enables some crazy aggressive plays. You can Flight dive the backline, kill, fly to cover, wait for Beam, and assassinate another.
* Hard to rely on the reset

* * To fully benefit from the Flight reset, you’ll want to fly in deep, secure an elim with Beam, then fly away. However, if the enemy survives your beam, you are left with no cooldowns and a death sentence.
* You should be used to Flight management and not leaving yourself exposed after Focusing Beam use. Therefore, you’ll have to adjust your playstyle to benefit from the Flight reset.

play_as: * Target Supports. Genji’s primary function is assassinating backlines. Use your mobility to bypass the enemy frontline, get close to the Supports, and kill them first.
* Always flank. Genji shouldn’t ever be standing in the front or middle of objective areas. Position on the perimeter of the fight, and attack from the side or behind the enemy.

* Support players know to save ults like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier to counter Blade. If you suspect they have a defensive ult available, hold on to Blade until your team has forced out their ult.
play_against: * Don’t get isolated. Genji is one of the best 1v1 duelists in OW, so stay close to your allies so he always has to fight at least two enemies.

* Force out ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/deflect.png)Deflect by dealing damage with your standard weapon, then use your cooldown abilities to punish him when he doesn’t have it.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot alone interrupts Genji's entire game plan. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/swift-strike.png)Swift Strike gets shut down when used as an attack or mobility option when booped by Brig. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira

Unlike ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/brigitte.png)Brigitte, however, Moira struggles to keep her allies alive against Genji. Moira is an easier way to survive against and kill Genji, but Brig is technically the better counter.

Also, maps with ledges near the objective create to possibility of instant kills by booping them off the map.

* Protect your backline. Lucio’s speed and knockback allow him to be a great protector of his backline from enemy flanks and dives. Speed over and help with a counterattack.
play_against: * Knockback or stun him. Anything that stops or slows his momentum makes Lucio easier to eliminate.

* When you see Lucio use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier try to disengage from the fight and wait out the overhealth instead of trying to fight through it.

minor.title: Pyromaniac
content: * Adds a small burst of instant overhealth whenever you ignite an enemy. Good for survivability, and best when having to play more passively.

major.title: Firewalker
content: * Best Major Perk

* * Ignited enemies take 15 damage per second, and can immediately be auto-crit by Cha-Cha. Since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga is unstoppable during Overrun, he can easily ignite multiple enemies with each use.

* * Slam onto an enemy, and they're instantly ignited. If you center slam their head, you’ll even get healing from the slam's critical hit. Plus, you’ll be dealing damage faster because you don’t have to spend time igniting them with primary fire before getting in the auto-crits.

* Soft counter to anti-healing and damage mitigation

* * Where Combat Fuel can be useful is in matchups with anti-heal like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana nade, or Tanks who can mitigate your entire Cardiac duration. The extra overhealth could theoretically keep you alive.

* Even if half the enemy team is not frozen and can shoot you, you can wall them, heal up yourself and your team while eliminating the enemies that are frozen. Then you have an easy clean up against those left.

* Good for survivine damage over time and so you don't have to spend so much time in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cryo-freeze.png)Cryo-Freeze during your ult.

* Has a low maximum height, so you can't jump off high ground and activate it to get an extra boost.

* Especially good on high maps with a bit of high ground like King's Row and Blizzard World where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei normally has a weakness against heroes with vertical mobility.

major.title: Deep Freeze
content: * Play close and hold corners
* * The ability to freeze enemies means you’ll want to spend as much time in primary fire range as possible. Position up front with your tank, or find enemies you can flank.
* When defending, stay at the choke and any corners. This forces close-range fights. Anyone who approaches you has to deal with the threat of being frozen, on top of getting walled off.
* Anti-Dive
* * Freezing any dive DPS is a death sentence for them. When the enemy team has mobility heroes giving you a hard time, shut them down with the Deep Freeze.

major.title: Cryo-Storm
content: * Big damage potential
* * Cryo-Storm deals 70 damage every second for up to 350 damage total.
* Try to trap an enemy in a corner or between Ice Wall and Cryo-storm.
* Block doorways
* * As noted in the Cryo-Freeze tips, blocking doorways is very strong for capturing and stalling objectives. Cryo-Storm adds damage as well, making the tactic even better!
* Ult charge
* * The extra damage Mei deals from Cryo-Storm adds up to a lot of extra ult generation over the course of a game. This is especially true when getting multiple enemies in your AoE.
* Blizzard combo

map_recommendations.maps_summary: The best maps to play Soldier: 76 on are maps with lots of flank routes. Having excellent ground mobility, but not vertical mobility, means flat levels maximize his Sprint value and minimize his vertical weakness. If the high ground areas are easily accessible, however, he should certainly be looking to take them. You’ll also want to look for longer sight lines as his weapons are best suited for medium-range engagements. Maps that force close-quarters combat are difficult for Soldier as he gets outclassed by heroes like Tracer and Genji. Really long sight lines are also a problem for him if the enemy is running snipers like Widow Maker.

* Be smart about where you position yourself when the Rush ends. You’d have to get 6 impacts to fully refresh the Rush if you don’t have either charge up.

major.title: Hungering Blaze
content: * Extremely potent survival ability.

* Being in range of multiple enemies is even more important when using Hungering Blaze. As mentioned under Ability Tips, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran will stay invulnerable for longer and additionally heal herself more.
* Recommended Major Perk.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina performs best on maps with strong choke points and long hallways, such as **Havana**, **Junkertown**, and **Midtown**. These maps favor poke compositions, which Domina pairs well with and counters effectively thanks to her high barrier uptime and ranged attacks.
She struggles most with two types of maps. The first are those with very tight spaces, such as **New Junk City** and **Antarctic Peninsula**. While she can work with the right comps—provided you rotate and maintain optimal distance—it can be a significant struggle.
Maps with an abundance of high ground, such as **Watchpoint: Gibraltar** and **Numbani**, give her the most trouble. As stated under "Weaknesses" above, Domina struggles against high-mobility and dive heroes who thrive on these vertical layouts.

play_as: * Always play near cover. Peek out for the beam burst, and quickly hide between shots.
* Use your range to target DPS and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports to get a quick elim or force them to retreat.
* Position around the perimeter of objectives so you can contest without getting surrounded.
play_against: * AoE and explosive damage can be used to destroy multiple barrier panels at once.
* Dive counters her playstyle. Overwhelm her by quickly getting behind her barrier.
* If a teammate gets imprisoned by her ult. Help them destroy the barrier from the outside.
play_against_summary: * AoE and explosive damage can be used to destroy multiple barrier panels at once.
* Dive counters her playstyle. Overwhelm her by quickly getting behind her barrier.
* If a teammate gets imprisoned by her ult. Help them destroy the barrier from the outside.

minor.title: Efficient Design
content: * Best for defensive play.
* When using Efficient Design, always wait to take a bit of damage before deploying her barrier.

minor.title: Extended Power
content: * Better for offense.
* Extending your primary fire by 5m is very powerful; do not underestimate the strength of this minor perk.

* After activating, experiment with the increased range. Keep rotating during fights, and abuse your superior range when battling ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks.
* Ignore the enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank and use your Beam to Target squishy targets who think they are safe.

major.title: Disruptive Detonation
content: * Aim to detonate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/crystal-charge.png)Crystal Charge between two enemies to maximize the perk’s CC effect.
* Slow down the enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank's approach, and hinder enemies trying to escape.
* Recommended Major Perk

major.title: Power Move
content: * Good to give ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina counterplay against melee heroes.

* Once the enemy is in melee range, first deploy barrier behind them, then use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sonic-repulsors.png)Sonic Repulsors to wall slam them into your barrier.
* Power Move only causes barrier to act as a wall for Sonic wall slams. Enemies can still freely walk and move through it as usual.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
Emre performs best on maps with objective areas and sightlines that match his optimal range (e.g., Rialto, Nepal, Esperança). Ideally, he will play near Cyber Frag’s max range, where he can abuse the AoE damage paired with his rifle follow-up shots.
Smaller maps (e.g., Antarctic Peninsula, Oasis, New Junk City) feel cramped for Emre. Although he can get good value from grenades, he may struggle to utilize the rest of his kit effectively.
As long as he can maintain high ground, he performs decently on dive maps (e.g., Dorado, Watchpoint: Gibraltar), but he gets countered by dive heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va that are typically played on these maps.

play_as: * ADS as much as possible. Only unscope when there is no target, or when fighting at very close range.
* Keep yourself alive and don’t rely on Support healing. Use Siphon Blaster when you need healing.
* Throw Cyber Frag and quickly try to shoot the same target. Frag + headshot is his most lethal combo.
play_against: * If you don’t have good burst damage, try to escape during his Siphon Blaster, so you minimize how much life steal he can generate.
* Emre has no crowd control counters other than trying to dodge with Siphon Blasters. He’s an easy kill if you can stun or knock him around.
* Listen for his Ult voice line, and prepare to shoot Emre out of the sky.

* Emre has no crowd control counters other than trying to dodge with Siphon Blasters. He’s an easy kill if you can stun or knock him around.

minor.title: Suppressive Security
content: * Makes Emre’s Ult more lethal by making it easier to land follow-up Heavy shots.
* * Slow the enemy with light rounds, then finish them off with a heavy round.
* Enemies will be more hesitant to challenge your ult, thus making ulting a bit safer.

minor.title: Enhanced Agility
content: * Decent for escaping and evading while Siphon Blaster cools off.
* Since the blaster is constantly overheating (without Heat Sink), you can take advantage of moments when you need to let it cool off.
* The 20% increase in movement speed, on top of the base movement buff, makes escaping feel more realistic.

major.title: Heat Sink
content: * Recommended Major Perk
* Fire more shots for more total time. Also results in greater life steal. If you are confident in aiming Siphon Blaster, this is a great Perk. Allows you to play more aggressively.
* Especially good for dueling, and for when Tanks are pressuring you (easier to land more shots on their large bodies).

major.title: Cyber Adhesion
content: * Transforms Cyber Frag into a cyber semtex.
* Sneak up on an enemy, throw the nade to stick, and immediately ADS headshot. You’ll delete DPS and Supports.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/jetpack-cat.png)Jetpack Cat have plenty of vertical structures for her to fly around. High ground is especially strong since she can perma-fly. Numbani, Watchpoint: Gibraltar, and Paraiso, for example, all feature structural layouts that enable her to constantly reposition safely.
Flatter maps and those with wide open objective areas such as Samoa, Havana, and New Queen Street don't offer nearly as much room to play. On these maps, you'll typically need to position closer to your team and use them for safety.

play_as: * Fly outside of their range when faced against melee and close combat enemies such as Vendetta.
* Keep repositioning around vertical cover, walls, and structures to keep yourself out of enemy hitscan’s LoS.
* Target Tanks when going to environmental KOs with your ult. When there are no ledges, wait for an ally to use a high damage Ult like Death Blossom.
play_against: * Hitscan heroes are strong against Jetpack Cat. If they are giving you trouble, consider swapping.

* Jetpack Cat doesn’t generate a lot of sustain for their team. If your team has higher healing (Supports like Kiriko and Moira), you win team fights by slowly chipping away at their health while keeping your team alive.
* Immediately start shooting Jetpack Cat when they capture you or a teammate to stop them from getting an environmental KO.

minor.title: Ulterior Motive
content: * Refills fuel even during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/frenetic-flight.png)Frenetic Flight.
* Significantly increases mobility and flight uptime when you are healing.
* Dealing Damage does not convert into fuel.
* Recommended default Minor Perk

minor.title: Transport Shielding
content: * Best for strategic play-making. Allows you to take more damage while transporting an ally for a flank play. Also makes it safer to go for environmental KOs after your Ult.
* Recommended when playing with comms or frequently coordinating transport plays.

major.title: Headbutt
content: * Need to have almost half fuel and to travel ~8m to build enough momentum for the boop. (Displayed as VFX circling your screen)
* Works in transport mode
* Pair with Ulterior Motive for more frequent use.

major.title: Claws Out
content: * Best for consistent aggressive plays. If your team is using an aggressive closerange strategy such as brawl, rush or dive, having extra damage every 6-seconds on your melee is quite powerful.
* When your team is playing more distance or poke styles, you won’t have many opportunities to use Claws Out.
* Recommended Major Perk

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
Maps that encourage close-range or brawly fights are the best for Mizuki to make full use of his kit (e.g., Oasis, Samoa, King's Row). Not only do these maps favor team comps he works well with, but they also allow him to get value from both his AoE healing and bouncing projectiles.
Long-range maps, such as Circuit Royal, and high-ground maps like Numbani are the two types of maps where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mizuki.png)Mizuki will struggle the most. As long as he can stay with his team, he can make it work, but he'll often feel at a disadvantage compared to other heroes.

play_as: * Prioritize offense. Your healing is higher the more you deal damage.

* Save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/binding-chain.png)Binding Chain to use on enemies that get past your Tank. Keep them trapped and secure the elim.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kekkai-sanctuary.png)Kekkai Sanctuary to protect and heal your team, and to counter projectile Ults such as Soujourn’s Overclock.
play_against: * Stay outside his effective range. His abilities are close to medium-ranged, so attack him from distances where he cannot coutner attack.
* His single-target healing is low; you can burst down his allies even when he’s trying to heal them.
* Go inside his ultimate and force his team out. If you have melee or beam abilities, you can penetrate the Sanctuary walls.

* Go inside his ultimate and force his team out. If you have melee or beam abilities, you can penetrate the Sanctuary walls.

minor.title: Wellspring
content: * Helps keep your AoE healing higher and get it up sooner in fights.
* Good when your other Support lacks AoE healing.

minor.title: Exposed Soul
content: * Considering enemies tethered by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/binding-chain.png)Binding Chain can still attack you, it’s important to eliminate them as quickly as possible. Exposed Soul helps turn every successful chain into a KO.
* Best for duels and countering enemy dives.

major.title: Resonant Return
content: * To mazimize benefit of the extra bounce, try to use Healing Kasa when your team is positioned closely together.
* Good for increasing defensive capabilities.
* Best when you need to serve as the main source of your team’s sustain.

major.title: Quickstep
content: * Best for rush and dive comps, as it enables a hyper-aggressive team initiation.
* Similar to Lucio’s speed aura, communicating with your team via VC, ping, or a voice line like “3-2-1” is important for coordinating ability timings.
* * The speedboost window is short, so your team will get more benefit if they are prepared, instead of having to react once they realize the speed aura is active.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/vendetta.png)Vendetta is an versitile hero who can adapt her playstyle to most maps. The ones she'll struggle the most on are the traditional sniper maps like Circuit Royal and Havana. When playing these maps, take the extra time needed to path around the edges of the map and outside of the LoS of ranged enemies.
Her best maps have high ground she can set up on, drop down and engage without needing to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soaring-slice.png)Soaring Slice. Most maps have some areas where she can do this but Numbani and Watchpoint: Gibraltar are prime examples.

play_as: * Stage from off-angles and high ground to approach the enemy from angles they can’t see you coming.
* Prioritize high-value isolated targets, such as a Wuyang positioned behind the rest of his team.
* Use not only her block but also her mobility survive by evading enemy attacks.
play_against: * Maintain distance. Save your escape tool for when you see her use her sword toss dash. She can’t chase you if you reposition after.
* The moment she arrives, focus her. She won’t be able to escape for a few seconds, and that is your team’s best opportunity to punish her.
* Use crowd control to neutralize her. She can only try to dodge it as her shield does not absorb CC.

* Use crowd control to neutralize her. She can only try to dodge it as her shield does not absorb CC.

minor.title: Raging Storm
content: * Vendetta’s best sustain tool. Without this perk, you have to play way more passively and disengage far sooner.
* Recommended Minor Perk

minor.title: Extra Edge
content: * The best tip for Extra Edge is to not use it.
* In theory, you can get an extra projectile in before recharging, but this is very low impact.

major.title: Relentless
content: * Taking Relentless increases the Onslaught passive buffs from 25% attack speed up to 40%, and from 20% movement speed up to 32%.
* Incredibly strong when combined with Sihponning Strike, since you’ll be able to stay swinging for longer.
* Coordinate with your team because a pocketed Vendetta with full Relentless buff will feel unstoppable to the enemy team.
* Recommended Major perk

major.title: Siphoning Strike
content: * Decent extra AoE damage, and a bit of extra movement.
* Use if you struggle to be accurate with her primary fire and need the big swings to add consistent damage.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: The best maps for Freja complement her medium-long range positioning. She struggles one map areas with tight spaces and a lot of flat ground. Finding longer sight lines and high ground to set up on is the way Freja primarily wants to position on any map.

play_as: * Use Updraft to leap over walls and barriers, allowing you to attack enemies the rest of your team can't reach.
* Save at least one Quick Dash charge to dodge enemy flanks and dives.
* Focus on landing direct hits with Bola Shot to gain the Hindered and pull-in effects.
play_against: * Freja excels at focusing down one target, but is weak when there are multiple enemies. Position near your allies so you don’t end up in a 1v1 situation.
* If you see her use Updraft, know you have a 10-second window where she can’t target you behind cover or run away to high ground (unless she's using Rising Winds).
* Counter Freja by outranging her with a hitscan sniper, or overwhelming her with a close-range, high mobility hero.
play_against_summary: * Freja excels at focusing down one target, but is weak when there are multiple enemies. Position near your allies so you don’t end up in a 1v1 situation.
* If you see her use Updraft, know you have a 10-second window where she can’t target you behind cover or run away to high ground (unless she's using Rising Winds).
* Counter Freja by outranging her with a hitscan sniper, or overwhelming her with a close-range, high mobility hero.

minor.title: Relentless Barrage
content: * Recommended Minor Perk

* Significantly increases spam uptime. If you hit multiple direct hits in a row using the standard combo listed under ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) tips (6 primary fire > 1 Take Aim > repeat), you would have infinite ammo and never stop to reload.

minor.title: Momentum Boost
content: * Good use is as a counter pick against dive and melee heroes. The extra dash distance can give you the space needed to evade their attacks.

* Activating ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) mid-air still freezes Freja, which minimizes the benefit of this Perk.

major.title: Aerial Recovery
content: * Recommended Minor Perk.

* Every time you jump and use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/updraft.png)Updraft + ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) slow, you'll heal for over 75 HP. Even more when used off a ledge.

major.title: Rising Winds
content: * Considering the long cooldown of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/updraft.png)Updraft, doubling its uptime is a considerable buff.
* * Best when playing maps with walls to jump and shoot over.
* Also good as a counterpick against melee and very close-range heroes

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wuyang.png)Wuyang has good horizontal and vertical mobility, long-range damage, and medium-range healing. These attributes allow him to adapt to most maps.
Regardless of the map, he wants to take advantage of his curving projectile to hit around corners, and jiggle peek cover to minimize his exposure to damage.
The maps he struggles most on are those with high ground areas that are outside his jump reach. Watchpoint: Gibraltar and Numbani, for example, have objective areas surrounded by high ground that Wuyang can't reach to contest or follow his team.

play_as: * Wait to use your Ult until you or your selected ally is right next to enemies, so it doesn’t expire before getting into attack range.
* Use Overflow to refill Wuyang’s healing resource while healing your Tank’s large health pool.
* Combine Guardian Wave with another Support’s AoE healing, such as Moira’s Biotic Orb.
play_against: * When you see the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave slam, back off, wait a few seconds, then hard re-engage to wipe his team because they won’t have burst healing.
* After you see him use Rushing Torrent (often to refill healing resources), immediately rush at him to eliminate Wuyang while he’s unable to escape.
* His Ult has a short 3.5s duration. Run away, use cover, and escape tools your hero has because it’s basically impossible to survive if you get caught.

* After you see him use Rushing Torrent (often to refill healing resources), immediately rush at him to eliminate Wuyang while he’s unable to escape.
* His Ult has a short 3.5s duration. Run away, use cover, and escape tools your hero has because it’s basically impossible to survive if you get caught.

minor.title: Overflow
content: * Grants the ability to give more burst healing to your allies, and less offensive downtime for yourself due to less time spent reloading.
* Recommended Minor Perk

minor.title: Balance
content: * Allows you to focus even more on dealing damage. As long as you keep hitting enemies, your selected ally will keep benefitting from increased healing.

major.title: Ebb and Flow
content: * Not a terrible perk, but not worth taking over Falling Rain.
* May help with countering dive comps by improving your close-range capabilities.
* Try it out if you have been unable to get value out of your charged primary fire up to this point.

major.title: Falling Rain
content: * Very powerful for increasing total and burst damage.
* As soon as you unlock the Major Perk, you should start putting more emphasis on dealing damage.
* All the same tips from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/xuanwu-staff.png)Xuanwu Staff apply as the use case does not change.
